title: REQ · Worker config exposes work root, max budget, auto-publish and provider kind with defaults
summary: New WorkerConfig fields are parsed from YAML and defaulted
description: Context: WorkerConfig has no fields for work root, budget, publish mode or provider. Desired behavior: add WorkRoot (work_root), MaxBudget (max_budget, float USD), AutoPublish (auto_publish) and ProviderKind (provider_kind) and default them in LoadFS. Expected result: omitted keys yield work_root .storyforge/work, max_budget 5, auto_publish false, provider_kind mock. Why: safe supervised defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Given YAML omitting the new keys, when LoadFS runs, then WorkRoot is .storyforge/work, MaxBudget is 5, AutoPublish is false and ProviderKind is mock
Given YAML setting work_root, max_budget, auto_publish true and provider_kind claude, when LoadFS runs, then those values are returned unchanged
